0232Literature and linguistics

Unslop (Harbor)

rawmodels/unslop-harbor

Finish a tweet or write a HumanEval function body, graded by a rubric-based LLM judge with a separate length rule; code must pass its tests first.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • anti-slop reward training
  • LLM-judge reward calibration

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Tweets score by judge rubric q times a length factor; code scores q/10 only if all HumanEval tests pass. Reward is in [0, 1].

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-... harbor run -p tasks -a <agent> -m <model> -e docker

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download rawmodels/unslop-harbor --repo-type dataset --local-dir unslop-harbor

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/rawmodels/unslop-harbor --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: OpenRouter API key for the judge; Docker.

Evidence

The judge picked the human tweet over a rewritten one 98.3% of the time on 30 held-out tasks.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
